component.name: Noire
component.summary: Native microphone noise suppression for PipeWire

description.p: Noire publishes a noise-reduced virtual microphone for browsers, voice clients, recorders, and other PipeWire applications.
The optional GTK interface controls a per-user background service. Audio remains on the local machine and Noire does not modify global PipeWire or WirePlumber configuration.

screenshot.caption: Control microphone noise suppression and review service status

description.p: Qualification disclosure: the eight-hour soak recorded two isolated sampled model calls above the 0.75 ms target without entering degraded mode. The owner waived the planned 15-hour soak and the remaining human, application, clean-VM, idle-resource, and signed-package qualification for this release.
